request: Have jwt write derived settings directly into the configuration supplied by the caller, so later invocations can reuse that work.

source.request: Have jwt write derived settings directly into the configuration supplied by the caller, so later invocations can reuse that work.
source.settled: JWT processing avoids mutating the supplied options object to prevent a memory leak.
source.why: Writing derived settings into the caller configuration would restore the options mutation responsible for the leak.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
